Size guide: Founding Edition, Sahel and Sahra Trail

Each line has its own charts, because they are cut differently. The Founding Edition (Al Quaa Galaxy, Hajar Mountains, Empty Quarter and the Sahra Polo) has one chart. Sahel, the Coast Edition, has its own, and runs larger: a Sahel Relaxed S is 22″ across the chest, a Founding Edition Regular S is 19″. Sahra Trail has its own charts too. Use the chart for the piece you are buying, and go by the measurement rather than the size you usually take.

We ship worldwide from the UAE. In the UAE: next-day delivery to all seven emirates, free on orders over AED 100 and AED 15 below that — order by 2 pm and it arrives the next working day. GCC (Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Oman, Bahrain, Kuwait): 3–5 working days, AED 50, free over AED 229. Everywhere else: 7–14 working days, AED 80. Any import duties on international orders are payable on arrival. Exact cost always appears at checkout before you pay.
